# Retail CoD 1.5b dedicated server: squad says between squad members, 2026-11-14.
# client-probes/probe_squad on mp_carentan puts each client on a side and in a
# squad at its begin: 0 axis squad_alpha, 1 axis squad_alpha, 2 axis
# squad_bravo, 3 allies squad_alpha. Four plain probes, 1.5 s apart, all inside
# one `unshare -rn`:
#   COD_VERSION=1.5 COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29020 PROBE_SECS=45 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_squad mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <1.5, stock paks> --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29020 \
#       --probe-say "12:say_squad a0" --probe-say "16:say_team t0" --probe-secs 25
#   cargo run -p vcod -- ... --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29020 --probe-secs 25
#   cargo run -p vcod -- ... --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29020 --probe-say "12:say_squad b2" --probe-secs 25
#   cargo run -p vcod -- ... --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29020 --probe-say "12:say_squad a3" --probe-secs 25
# !say <client> <command> in the order games_mp.log logged them; !chat <client>
# every h/i line the client got, control bytes as \xNN; !log the say lines of
# games_mp.log.
!say 0 say_squad a0
!say 2 say_squad b2
!say 0 say_team t0
!say 3 say_squad a3
!chat 0 h "\x15\x15^9(\x14GAME_AXIS\x15 \x14PATCH_1_5_SQUADALPHA\x15)vcod^7: ^5a0"
!chat 0 i "\x15\x15^9(\x14GAME_AXIS\x15)vcod^7: ^5t0"
!chat 1 h "\x15\x15^9(\x14GAME_AXIS\x15 \x14PATCH_1_5_SQUADALPHA\x15)vcod^7: ^5a0"
!chat 1 i "\x15\x15^9(\x14GAME_AXIS\x15)vcod^7: ^5t0"
!chat 2 h "\x15\x15^9(\x14GAME_AXIS\x15 \x14PATCH_1_5_SQUADBRAVO\x15)vcod^7: ^5b2"
!chat 2 i "\x15\x15^9(\x14GAME_AXIS\x15)vcod^7: ^5t0"
!chat 3 h "\x15\x15^8(\x14GAME_ALLIES\x15 \x14PATCH_1_5_SQUADALPHA\x15)vcod^7: ^5a3"
!log saysquad;0;0;vcod;a0
!log saysquad;0;2;vcod;b2
!log sayteam;0;0;vcod;t0
!log saysquad;0;3;vcod;a3
